pois.name: Village of Nod
pois.gm_description: Home base for the party: the village of Nod. Main exports: hard cider, mushrooms, potatoes, and the proceeds of adventuring.

pois.name: Manchester
pois.gm_description: The city of Manchester. A den of sin and inequity. Guarded by Manchester United.

pois.name: Fey Entrance
pois.gm_description: The entrance to the Fey realms. Friendly, for the most part (but still can be dangerous).

pois.name: The Great Graveyard
pois.player_description: A very pleasant place for walks, this cemetery not far from town always seems to go just a bit further back. Be sure to place a silver ingot on any gravestone (but not TOO pure, for some reason).
pois.gm_description: This graveyard is actually nearly infinite: it warps space as you go further back. It has a pet cemetery near the front. The wizard who created it is still inside in suspended animation. It has magic to suppress the undead, which is powered by a block of mithril.

pois.name: Brandywine Waterfall
pois.rumored_description: A waterfall along the Brandywine stream up in the mountains. Incredible view, plus there are said to be caves behind it.
pois.gm_description: A waterfall along the Brandywine stream up in the mountains. Incredible view, a permanent rainbow, plus has caves behind it.

pois.name: Cloud Island
pois.rumored_description: Supposedly there's a spot near here where one can step directly into the clouds and walk across them.
pois.gm_description: Cloud Giants live in Cloud Island.

pois.name: The Cliffs of Insanity
pois.rumored_description: The Cliffs of Insanity are rumored to block the way to the Great Plateau.
pois.gm_description: I don't have a plan for this yet.

pois.name: Hydra
pois.rumored_description: A terrifying beast at the heart of Deepglow Swamp.
pois.gm_description: A truly dangerous creature with huge treasure, but it mostly just stays put.

pois.name: Elephant Graveyard
pois.rumored_description: An elephant graveyard deep in the jungle.
pois.gm_description: No GM plans yet. Lots of ivory as treasure.

pois.name: Brandywine Kraken
pois.rumored_description: Stories tell of a Kraken in the Brandywine river. That doesn't make sense, does it?.
pois.gm_description: Nope. It isn't real.

pois.name: Fallen Castle
pois.rumored_description: A flying castle is supposed to have crashed into the side of the mountain range.
pois.gm_description: The flying castle is from a powerful ancient civilization. The whole area around it is subject to "radiation", which changes the monsters.

pois.name: Wild Giant Boar
pois.gm_description: The best area to hunt wild giant boar.

pois.name: Roc
pois.gm_description: Top predator.

pois.name: Red Hand Bandit Camp
pois.rumored_description: The hidden camp of the Red Hand Bandits, a band of cuthroats under a one-eyed captain named "Anastasia".
pois.gm_description: The Red Hand bandits' hidden camp: a dozen cutthroats under a one-eyed captain named named "Anastasia". They prey on river traffic.

pois.name: Mushroomfolk
pois.rumored_description: This is the area where you've been told the mushroomfolk are to be found.
pois.gm_description: Town of Mushroomfolk.

pois.name: Giant Frog
pois.gm_description: Location for some giant frogs.

pois.name: Giant Frog
pois.gm_description: Location for some giant frogs.

pois.name: Mushroomfolk Runaways
pois.gm_description: A group of teenaged mushroomfolk running away from home.

pois.name: Orc Scouts
pois.player_description: A well-prepared scouting party of Orcs.
pois.gm_description: Scouting party of orcs; they have maps of the area.

pois.name: Dragon Bones
pois.gm_description: This is the skeleton of a dragon, killed many years ago.

pois.name: Redcaps
pois.gm_description: Redcaps are the most aggressive of the Fey. But they like apple cider.
